_about: Objective web & API items (HTTP semantics, REST design, browser security, rendering). The Ques document for this section has open-ended prompts only.

mcq.q: Which HTTP method is idempotent but NOT safe?
mcq.answer: PUT

mcq.q: Which status code indicates that a new resource was created successfully?
A logged-in user requests a resource they are not allowed to access. Which status code fits best?
Which response header tells browsers and proxies how long a response may be cached?
mcq.answer: Cache-Control

mcq.q: What does the SameSite=Strict cookie attribute do?
options: Stops the cookie from being sent on cross-site requests
Makes the cookie readable by JavaScript
Shares the cookie across all subdomains
mcq.answer: Stops the cookie from being sent on cross-site requests

mcq.q: Which cookie flag prevents client-side JavaScript from reading the cookie?
mcq.answer: HttpOnly

mcq.q: Which HTTP method does a CORS preflight request use?
mcq.answer: OPTIONS

mcq.q: Which statement about a standard signed JWT is true?
options: Its payload is only base64url-encoded, so anyone holding the token can read it
Its payload is encrypted by default
It must be stored in a database to be valid
mcq.answer: Its payload is only base64url-encoded, so anyone holding the token can read it

mcq.q: What is the strongest defence against stored XSS?
options: Context-aware output encoding combined with a Content Security Policy
mcq.answer: Context-aware output encoding combined with a Content Security Policy

mcq.q: What does it mean that HTTP is stateless?
options: Each request carries everything the server needs; the protocol keeps no memory of earlier requests
mcq.answer: Each request carries everything the server needs; the protocol keeps no memory of earlier requests

mcq.q: Which status code means a resource has moved permanently?
What does an ETag response header enable?
options: Conditional requests, so an unchanged resource can return 304 Not Modified
mcq.answer: Conditional requests, so an unchanged resource can return 304 Not Modified

mcq.q: How does PATCH differ from PUT?
options: PATCH applies a partial update; PUT replaces the whole resource
PUT is only for creating resources
mcq.answer: PATCH applies a partial update; PUT replaces the whole resource

mcq.q: When is cursor-based pagination preferred over offset pagination?
options: When data changes frequently and pages must stay consistent at scale
When the dataset has fewer than 10 rows
When clients need to jump to an arbitrary page number
mcq.answer: When data changes frequently and pages must stay consistent at scale

mcq.q: Which status code is standard when a client exceeds a rate limit?
What does the Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header do?
options: Tells browsers to use only HTTPS for the domain
mcq.answer: Tells browsers to use only HTTPS for the domain

mcq.q: Which browser storage is automatically sent to the server with every request to its domain?
mcq.answer: Cookies

mcq.q: How do you protect a cookie-authenticated form POST from CSRF?
options: Include a per-session anti-CSRF token that the server validates
mcq.answer: Include a per-session anti-CSRF token that the server validates

mcq.q: What does 409 Conflict typically indicate?
options: The request conflicts with the resource's current state, such as a duplicate or version mismatch
The client is not logged in
mcq.answer: The request conflicts with the resource's current state, such as a duplicate or version mismatch

mcq.q: What most reduces latency for users around the world fetching static assets?
options: Serving them from CDN edge locations close to users
mcq.answer: Serving them from CDN edge locations close to users

mcq.q: What does this JavaScript print, line by line?
mcq.answer: A C B
mcq.explanation: Synchronous code runs first, then microtasks (promises), then macrotasks (timers).

mcq.q: What does React's virtual DOM primarily optimise?
options: Minimising real DOM updates by diffing and batching changes
mcq.answer: Minimising real DOM updates by diffing and batching changes

mcq.q: In server-side-rendered frameworks, what is 'hydration'?
options: Attaching client-side JavaScript and event handlers to server-rendered HTML
mcq.answer: Attaching client-side JavaScript and event handlers to server-rendered HTML

mcq.q: Which request header normally carries a bearer token?
mcq.answer: Authorization

mcq.q: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE is recommended for:
options: Public clients such as single-page and mobile apps
mcq.answer: Public clients such as single-page and mobile apps

mcq.q: In a payments API, what do idempotency keys prevent?
options: Duplicate charges when clients retry a request
mcq.answer: Duplicate charges when clients retry a request

mcq.q: Which is the most RESTful endpoint for fetching the orders of user 42?
mcq.answer: GET /users/42/orders

mcq.q: Which serialisation format does gRPC use by default?
mcq.answer: Protocol Buffers

mcq.q: What is GraphQL's main advantage for clients compared with fixed REST endpoints?
options: Requesting exactly the fields needed in a single round trip
It removes the need for authentication
It always caches better over HTTP
mcq.answer: Requesting exactly the fields needed in a single round trip

mcq.q: What are WebSockets best suited for?
mcq.answer: Bidirectional, low-latency real-time communication

mcq.q: What does 504 Gateway Timeout mean?
options: A gateway or proxy did not receive a timely response from an upstream server
The user must log in again
mcq.answer: A gateway or proxy did not receive a timely response from an upstream server

mcq.q: What is the purpose of a Content Security Policy (CSP)?
options: Restricting which sources may load scripts and other resources
mcq.answer: Restricting which sources may load scripts and other resources
